high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Sophia Kianni, the founder of Phia, a company that has raised $8 million to hire individuals who are highly motivated and willing to work hard. The post highlights the rapid growth of Phia, noting 500,000 users in just five months, 5,000 brand partners, and millions of dollars in sales. The text in the post emphasizes the importance of the team's obsessive work ethic and quick actions.
